lines.en: Every step I take shakes the trees.

lines.zh: 四格高的身体，转身很慢。
lines.en: Four blocks tall — I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 玻璃罩里全是我的呼吸声。
lines.en: My breathing fills the dome.

lines.zh: 我踩碎脚下的石头，不弯腰。
lines.en: I crush stones underfoot without bending.

lines.zh: 这台机器走路像在打鼓。
lines.en: This machine walks like a drum.
I do not fly. I press the ground.

lines.zh: 关节里有怪声，老化了吗。
lines.en: Odd sounds in my joints. Worn out?
Each stride must be calculated.
Snow turns to black muck under me.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的树一把推开。
lines.en: I shove a blocking tree aside.
The skull inside the dome feels stifled.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一座废掉的高塔。
lines.en: I stand like an abandoned tower.
This body needs no rest.
I am measuring the terrain.
Another scratch on the dome.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，看了看关节。
lines.en: I raise an arm and study the joint.
Silence is good for thinking.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在玻璃上起雾。
lines.en: My breath fogs the glass.
These people are so small I barely see them.
I remember having been a man.
The grass is flattened under me.
I am waiting for my energy to recover.
This body outlasts me.
I open my fingers slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，罩子上的光一闪。
lines.en: I lift my chin; light slides over the dome.
You reach my knee, at best.

lines.zh: 抬头，我需要看清你的表情。
lines.en: Look up. I need your face.
You linger too long at my feet.

lines.zh: 这具三格宽的铁身，还没听够。
lines.en: This three-block iron body has not heard enough.

lines.zh: 你打算跑？我一步抵你十步。
lines.en: Run? My stride is ten of yours.
I know you resent this.

lines.zh: 你这副身板，我不必用力。
lines.en: A build like yours needs no effort.

lines.zh: 我弯不下腰，你上来说话。
lines.en: I cannot bend. Come up to speak.

lines.zh: 你身上有值得研究的成分。
lines.en: You have something worth studying.

lines.zh: 我的头颅在罩子里，别盯着看。
lines.en: My skull sits in glass. Stop staring.
Two steps back. Correct.
The ground shakes when I speak.

lines.zh: 你手上那把东西伤不了我。
lines.en: That thing in your hand cannot hurt me.
I do not hate you. You are just in the way.

lines.zh: 你想知道我是谁？先活下来。
lines.en: Want to know who I am? Survive first.
I see youth in you.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，你就退了。
lines.en: I lift a hand and you retreat.
The shell dents. Function remains.
I give half a step and steady.

lines.zh: 这一下有点分量，机械身体也晃了。
lines.en: That had weight; even this machine body shook.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的关节在响。
lines.en: I hear my joints complain.
A crack spreads across the dome.
I lower my stance a little.
That wound buys you nothing.
I exhale a foul breath.
I raise a hand to guard my skull.
Food means nothing to me.
What do you hope to buy with that?
I cannot even recall taste.
What you offer is too small.
Put it down. I cannot reach.
This body does not eat.
Your kindness is a little naive.
I lower my gaze to it.
A tribute? It falls short.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: You strike me and I barely feel it.

lines.zh: 我的腿比你整间屋子还粗。
lines.en: My leg is thicker than your house.
Move. I cannot turn aside.
Did I step on you? Apologies.

lines.zh: 这一下震得你耳朵疼吧。
lines.en: That ringing must hurt your ears.

lines.zh: 我抬脚很慢，别站在前面。
lines.en: I lift my foot slowly. Do not stand there.
A dent in my plating.
You are pushed aside.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就直接走过去。
lines.en: Once more and I simply walk through.
I am only a head.
That subject is meaningless to me.
I once had a body of my own.
Do not jest about it.
My life has been the study of power.
Inside the dome, I smile.
I turn my head away.

lines.zh: 冷得像铁，这就是我的回答。
lines.en: Cold as iron — that is my answer.
Spare me the words.
I pinch it up like a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，我几乎看不见。
lines.en: So small I can hardly see it.

lines.zh: 我把它放进罩旁的槽里。
lines.en: I drop it into the slot beside my dome.
Bending is out of the question.
I nudge it over with my toe.
This is useful to me.
I heard it land — metal.
I stow it in my arm plate.
Ground loot is mine first.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，看看有没有踩坏。
lines.en: I lift my foot to check I did not crush it.
You are locked.
Ki gathers in my palm.

lines.zh: 你逃不出这一步的距离。
lines.en: You cannot escape one stride.
This is for the experiment.
I raise my arm, slowly.
Hold. My strike is faster.

lines.zh: 你想被我研究，还是想死？
lines.en: Study or death — choose.

lines.zh: 你被记录在我的数据里。
lines.en: You are now in my data.
My fist is at the top of its arc.
This comes without warning.
A ki burst forms in my palm.

lines.zh: 你这么小，我得瞄得准些。
lines.en: So small — I must aim carefully.
Do not dodge. Stand still.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，罩子里在响。
lines.en: When I laugh, the dome rattles.
I have your distance calculated.
You are within three of my strides.

lines.zh: 四格高的身子，转身要很久。
lines.en: Four blocks tall; turning takes me a while.
Ki glows between my fingers.
Circling is useless; I pivot in place.
You are hunting my weakness.

lines.zh: 玻璃罩不是弱点，别想了。
lines.en: The dome is not a weakness. Stop hoping.
My arm is at shoulder height.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我眼里是纸。
lines.en: Your armor reads as paper to me.
I wait for your first move.
Not my face — watch the fist.
You are inside my shadow.
I begin to draw the next breath.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，气弹聚在掌心。
lines.en: I raise my arm, ki gathering in my palm.
My palm falls and the ground sinks.
I sweep with the back of my hand.
My fist goes through your guard.
You are batted away.

lines.zh: 我的关节响了一声才动。
lines.en: My joint clicks before it moves.
How are you so light?
I stamp down — slow, heavy.
Ki follows the fist.
Half my strength went into that.
I push the ki from my palm.
Your weapon broke.
The impact rings in my own ears.
Another palm follows.
The shattered stones are still falling.

lines.zh: 抱歉，这具身体收不住力。
lines.en: Apologies — this body cannot hold back.
I rise from the earth.

lines.zh: 脚下的建筑被我踩平了。
lines.en: The building flattens under my feet.
From the dome, I look at you all.
This place is tall enough. Good.

lines.zh: 我来的时候带起一阵土。
lines.en: I arrive trailing a cloud of dust.

lines.zh: 你那点武器，抬出来看看。
lines.en: Show me that weapon of yours.

lines.zh: 我的头颅在玻璃里转了一圈。
lines.en: My skull turns once inside the glass.
Low buildings again.
I brush the dirt off my shoulder.
Four blocks tall — I barely fit through doors.

lines.zh: 你就是这个星球上最强的？
lines.en: Are you the strongest on this world?
My breathing chills the air.
I raise my hand and the sky dims.
Show me your ki.
One step of mine and the ground splits.
Do not bother fleeing.

lines.zh: 这台身体还能再动很久。
lines.en: This body can keep moving a long while.
I have waited far too long.

lines.zh: 火焰包住我的腿，玻璃发烫。
lines.en: Fire wraps my leg; the glass heats.

lines.zh: 我倒下去，砸穿了两层地面。
lines.en: I fall and punch through two floors.

lines.zh: 水里我动不了，沉得很快。
lines.en: In water I cannot move; I sink fast.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀得歪了半边。
lines.en: The blast tips me half over.
The arrow shatters on my plating.

lines.zh: 咒力钻过甲缝，碰到我的脑子。
lines.en: Magic slides through a seam and touches my brain.
Even this body burns fuel.

lines.zh: 雷电灌进关节，我僵了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning floods my joints; I lock up.

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我连头都保不住。
lines.en: No ground beneath — I cannot even save my head.
